the rice starches treated with annealing or heat-moiture treatment could be used to improve the cooking and textural quality of rice noodles.

the hydrothermal treated rice flour could produce rice noodle of acceptable quality and the characterization of starches by RVA and texture analysis could be used for predicting the quality and acceptability of rice noodle.
the quality of the rice noodle can be improved by hydrothermal treatment of rice starch.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the utilization of hydrothermally treated rice starches for improvement of rice noodles.
the utilization of low quality rice flour and hydrothermally treated rice starch for the improvement of the cooking quality and texture of rice noodles.
the development of a novel approach for the production of rice noodle with acceptable quality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
rice starches with low gelatinization temperatures could be a good source for improving the quality of low quality rice flour.
hydrothermal treatments of rice flour can be a potential method for improving rice noodle quality.
the hydrothermal treatments of starch could effectively improve the quality of rice noodles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the rice starches with improved functional properties could be used as a potential ingredient to produce rice noodles with better quality and the characterization of flour by RVA viscosities and hardness of gel could be a practical method for quality prediction of the derived noodles.
hydrothermal treatment is a potential technique to improve the quality of noodles from low quality rice flour.
the quality of rice noodles could be improved by the use of hydrothermal treated starches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of heat-moist treatment (HMT) of rice starches can improve the cooking and texture qualities of rice noodles, especially when the rice flour has low gelatinization temperature.
the use of hydrothermal treatments of rice flour could improve the cooking and texture properties of rice noodles.
hydrothermal treatments could be used as a practical method for the improvement of rice flour quality for the production of rice noodle.
